title: New law: To amend title XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to permit a waiver of the prohibition of offering nurse aide training and competency evaluation programs in certain nursing facilities. (Public Law 105-15)
summary: H.R. 968 of the 105th Congress became Public Law 105-15 on 1997-05-15.

title: New law: A bill to authorize the President to award a gold medal on behalf of the Congress to Francis Albert "Frank" Sinatra in recognition of his outstanding and enduring contributions through his entertainment career and humanitarian activities, and for other purposes. (Public Law 105-14)
summary: S. 305 of the 105th Congress became Public Law 105-14 on 1997-05-14.

title: New law: To extend the term of appointment of certain members of the Prospective Payment Assessment Commission and the Physician Payment Review Commission. (Public Law 105-13)
summary: H.R. 1001 of the 105th Congress became Public Law 105-13 on 1997-05-14.
